address: 17/J, 18th Cross Rd, Sector 3, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102
review_text: A calm, aesthetic café hidden inside HSR Layout. I ordered a mini feast: chicken stroganoff, green apple soda, iris lemonade, grilled chicken steak, rosemary chicken steak, and veg spring roll. Everything looked Insta-ready and tasted amazing… except the spring roll, which turned out to be a spring troll. For reasons known only to the universe, we waited one full hour for this tiny roll to roll into our table—and it arrived last, dramatically, like it was the chief guest. Sadly, it tasted like it should’ve stayed backstage. So yes, one star gone.  But overall, a perfect spot for a chill dinner with friends and family. Still recommending it—just maybe skip the spring roll unless you enjoy suspense thrillers. 😄

review_text: I found the food underwhelming. The main issue is all the dishes we ordered tasted the same. Stuffed mushrooms (pictured), chicken stroganoff, ravioli. Bangalore has many good places and this is - almost certainly -the most 'meh' stuffed mushrooms I have had in years. The only good dish was the Tiramisu.  The other issue is price. Too expensive for what it offers. No water offered. In house packed bottle also costs? Wouldn't recommend. There are many many better places around. Perhaps the sandwiches/pizzas are better - avoid the main dishes.  Location and decor are very good. No issues with service as well (but hey - offer water at least?)

review_text: IRIS Cafe, HSR Layout: A Charming Urban Retreat.  Ambiance & Vibe Nestled in the vibrant heart of HSR Layout, IRIS Cafe strikes a perfect balance between cozy and chic. The decor blends modern minimalism with whimsical touches—think fairy lights, potted plants, and quirky wall art. With both indoor and outdoor seating, it caters to diverse moods: the alfresco area is ideal for Bangalore’s pleasant weather, while the indoor space, adorned with bookshelves and soft music, suits quiet work sessions.  IRIS Cafe’s menu is a delightful mix of global and Indian comfort food. Standouts include:  Loaded Nachos: Crispy, generously topped with melted cheese, salsa, and guacamole.  Truffle Fries: Aromatic and perfectly seasoned.  Paneer Tikka Sandwich: A fusion hit with soft, spiced paneer and fresh bread.  cheese Cake / brownie - Rich, moist, and visually stunning.  Their coffee deserves special mention—try the Cold Brew or Cappuccino, both robust and smooth. Staff are courteous and attentive, though hospitality is very good presented by Maya n Ajeet.
